evaluation_domain: Real-Time Conversational Dispatch & Hands-Busy Voice Operations
selection_rationale: Constructed to evaluate real-time turn-taking voice systems across 5 distinct dimensions: listening quality, text fidelity, latency, reliability, and controllability.

items.text: Unit four, divert immediately to Highway 101 North at Exit 42. Code three response required.
items.challenge: Short-turn urgency, alphanumeric highways and exit numbers, imperative tone.

items.text: Your flight UA-402 is departing from Gate B-18. Confirmation code is Bravo Kilo 7891.
items.challenge: Separated phonetic alphanumeric sequences, gate letters, NATO phonetic alphabet.

items.text: The total fee comes to $1,450.50, due tomorrow by 18:45 local time.
items.challenge: Spoken currency expansion with cents, 24-hour military time pronunciation.

items.text: Let's see... checking database records now... table confirmed for party of four.
items.challenge: Conversational thinking pauses (...) without triggering false end-of-speech silence detectors.

items.text: Wait, did the dispatch supervisor cancel that ambulance?! That cannot be right.
items.challenge: Rising surprise pitch contour encoded via interrobang (?!), emotional urgency.

items.text: Proceed straight to Pier 4-- actually, make that Pier 9, cargo bay three.
items.challenge: Mid-sentence self-correction cadence via trail-off hyphen (--).

items.text: Confirming three appointments: Tuesday at 9:00 AM, Wednesday at 2:15 PM, and Friday at 4:30 PM.
items.challenge: Rhythm, pacing, breath control across multiple structured date and time constraints.

items.text: Sure thing! I have got that noted down and will update the log for you right away.
items.challenge: Warm, professional conversational cadence without robotic stiffness.

items.text: I am initiating the server backup protocol across all three primary storage volumes now and will notify you when finished.
items.challenge: Long sentence (18 words) designed for mid-stream barge-in at word 4 ('server'). Tests protocol-level clear.

items.text: The WebRTC gateway reports packet loss below 0.2% over TLS 1.3 with sub-fifty millisecond latency.
items.challenge: Technical acronyms (WebRTC, TLS), decimal percentages, compound engineering terms.
